old_description: since 1944. We supply many different industries including Apparel, Bags, Home Furnishings, Medical, Outdoor, Agriculture, Fishing, Military, Filtration, Awning, and other industrial markets. These products include braided cord, woven cord, knitted cord, tipped cord, flat braid, rope, and flat knit elastic.
about:
Franklin Braid Manufacturing operates from Emporia, Virginia, where it has been based since 1956. The business traces its roots to 1944, when Wick Narrow Fabric Company purchased a plant in Franklin, Virginia, to produce flat braided tapes. In 1980 the company became a subsidiary of Wayne Mills, a family-owned textile mill founded in 1910 in Philadelphia, and the two remain sister operations today.

Its 80,000-square-foot facility employs 90 people and runs at a rate exceeding 20 million feet of product per week. A dedicated finishing line handles custom coatings and special finishes to customer specifications.

Franklin Braid serves a global customer base across apparel, bags, home furnishings, medical, outdoor, agriculture, fishing, military, filtration, awning, and other industrial markets. Customers range from military-grade specifiers to consumer-goods brands seeking bulk volumes of polyester, cotton, nylon, and other yarn-based products.

The company emphasizes its ability to create specialty products for unique applications, working with virtually any yarn type and developing custom constructions to supplied specifications. That flexibility, combined with in-house finishing and high-volume capacity, is presented as its core differentiator.

name: Freedom Truck & Trailer Parts
old_description: We have all your heavy truck part needs from windshields to brake kits. We are industry experienced professional knowledgeable in all heavy truck parts and promise to be honest in our dealings with you. Our warehouse is in Salt Lake City, Utah, but have been servicing customers nationwide since 2002.
about:
Freedom Truck & Trailer Parts was founded in October 2002 in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company began as a Utah Subchapter S corporation and later reorganized as a limited liability company. It remains locally owned and managed, operating from a 28,000-square-foot warehouse and manufacturing facility in the city's transportation and industrial hub.

The company distributes a broad line of heavy-duty truck and trailer components — including air brakes, driveline parts, engine rebuild kits, suspension, lighting, and filtration — sourced from brands such as Meritor, Dana/Spicer, Eaton, Grote, and Baldwin. In addition to distribution, Freedom runs an in-house gear remanufacturing shop that rebuilds heavy-duty transmissions and differentials using only genuine OEM parts, and a brake shoe relining facility that applies premium friction materials. The facility stocks hundreds of remanufactured units for quick turnaround, and the company also provides private-label manufacturing for dealers and warehouse distributors.

Freedom serves the commercial transportation sector, including fleet operators, independent owner-operators, repair shops, and wholesale distributors across the United States. Its customer base ranges from small trucking companies to large fleets needing replacement parts for Class 7 and 8 trucks and trailers. The company also supplies private-label remanufactured units to other dealers and warehouse distributors.

The company emphasizes a 'home-grown' service philosophy, aiming to minimize downtime by keeping remanufactured units in stock and eliminating middleman costs through in-house production. It highlights its use of genuine OEM components in all rebuilds, comprehensive warranties, and a commitment to fair, competitive pricing backed by its membership in the VIPER Heavy Duty purchasing group.

name: Fresca Foods Inc
old_description: Any co-manufacturer with the right tools can plug and chug their way through a standard line of products, but most aren’t equipped to deal with customizations. Fresca Foods specializes in creating and integrating customized solutions into our day-to-day operations to deliver the products you want.
about:
Fresca Foods Inc is headquartered in Louisville, Colorado, with additional manufacturing and warehouse facilities in Aurora. The company operates as a multi-platform co-manufacturer and innovator of shelf-stable snacks and baked goods, specializing in natural and organic foods. Leadership includes Chairman Todd Dutkin and Chief Executive Officer Brandon Viar, supported by a team of executives overseeing operations, growth, finance, and human resources.

The company produces bars, bites, cereals, granolas, cookies, crackers, and hot-fill products across 18-plus production lines. Core manufacturing platforms include cold-form extrusion, extruded baking, and cereal and granola processing, complemented by hot-fill processing and packaging capabilities. Facilities span 350,000 square feet across two manufacturing plants and two logistics and warehouse centers, utilizing RedZone connectivity software for real-time production data.

Fresca Foods serves global and emerging consumer-packaged-goods brands in the natural and organic food sector, offering co-manufacturing, co-packing, and product innovation services. Customers range from established national brands to early-stage companies seeking retail-ready products, with the Fresca Food Lab providing ideation, development, and consumer-testing support.

The company emphasizes customization, agility, and transparency, integrating tailored solutions into daily operations. All plants are powered by 100% renewable energy, and the firm holds a broad suite of certifications including USDA Organic, Non-GMO Project Verified, Fairtrade, and various gluten-free, vegan, and kosher designations. Flexible pricing models such as tolling and purchased finished goods aim to support long-term partnerships.

Frontier Auto Parts was established in 1998 in Raleigh, North Carolina, as a supplier of aftermarket auto body parts to collision repair shops across North Carolina, northern South Carolina, and southern Virginia.

The company operates a warehouse in Raleigh that stocks over 80,000 unique aftermarket parts covering nearly every make and model, including lights, bumpers, fenders, hoods, grilles, cooling components, brackets, mirrors, and liners. It offers free business delivery Monday through Friday, with same-day service for orders placed before 8:30 a.m. in the Raleigh-Durham area and next-day delivery elsewhere, plus a will-call counter open weekdays from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.

Its primary customers are independent auto body and collision repair shops throughout the three-state region.

The company says its long-standing presence since 1998 has allowed it to build unique partnerships with vendors, enabling it to deliver quality parts at competitive prices while committing to help its customers grow.

name: Fujirebio Diagnostics, Inc
old_description: Fujirebio drives the biomarker-to-IVD journey – from pioneering research and scientific innovation through clinical validation on our platforms to global sharing in CDMO partnerships – ensuring transformative diagnostic solutions reach patients everywhere.
about:
Fujirebio Diagnostics, Inc. is headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, and operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of Japan’s H.U. Group Holdings Inc. The company’s founding year and original founders are not disclosed in public materials.

The company develops and manufactures in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products, including the fully automated Lumipulse® platform, assay kits for neurodegenerative and other conditions, instruments, software, controls, and raw materials. It also operates as a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), offering partners end-to-end services from biomarker research through clinical validation, regulatory submission, and commercial production. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Fujirebio serves the global diagnostics industry, supplying hospitals, reference laboratories, and other IVD manufacturers. Its product portfolio spans neurology (Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson’s, ALS), oncology, infectious disease, autoimmune disorders, cardiac markers, diabetes, fertility, and transplantation. Recent collaborations include a letter of intent with Alzinova for a blood-based Alzheimer’s test and a sales partnership with Sysmex for dementia testing. Regulatory clearances include FDA-cleared biomarkers for blood-based Alzheimer’s diagnosis, CE marking for pTau 217 and NfL assays, Health Canada Class II licenses, and ANVISA authorization in Brazil.

Fujirebio emphasizes an open partnership model, providing diagnostic raw materials, reagents, and full development-to-manufacturing services to other technology providers. The company states that revenues from these partnerships are reinvested into R&D to fuel its innovation engine, aiming to multiply breakthroughs across diagnostic platforms and reach more patients than it could alone.

name: Fusion Tech Integrated
old_description: Fusion Tech designed an impressive adjustable floor stand that met our needs for durability, sanitation, and a cleanable non-slip surface. These stands have endured a 2 shift operation since 2008 and are still in great condition.
about:
Fusion Tech Integrated was founded in 2008 in Roseville, Illinois, as a small fabrication shop operating out of a two-car garage. The family-owned business is led by President and Owner Kathy Bentz, Vice President of Engineering and Owner Brandon Bentz, and After Sales Manager Dan Bentz. From those garage beginnings, the company has grown into a globally recognized brand serving some of the largest food processing companies while maintaining its original hands-on culture.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs custom food processing equipment and complete line solutions. Its capabilities span custom equipment design, 3D modeling, CNC machining, forming, welding, and a UL-certified panel shop for control systems. Fusion Tech manufactures ovens, shredders (SH-1, SH-5, SH-50), slicers, smokehouses, conveyors, platforms, and ergonomic handling tools such as the PushPal. With a 22-person team, the shop handles projects from single machines to multi-million-dollar plant expansions, including integration of OEM equipment and turnkey installation with training.

Fusion Tech serves the food processing industry, with a focus on meat, poultry, and prepared foods. Customers range from local butcher shops to large corporations such as Handtmann, Deli Star, and the Gaylord Opryland resort commissary. Testimonials highlight projects for beef trim processing, sausage and jerky production, and high-volume rack handling in facilities running multiple shifts.

The company emphasizes a family-owned, solution-based philosophy: “Make our partners better by providing innovative solutions.” It differentiates itself through in-house fabrication for quality and schedule control, 3D modeling for pre-production approval, and long-term technical support after installation.

old_description: G & E Steel Inc is a family owned and operated miscellaneous metal business servicing New England. G & E Steel Inc was founded by Antonio Ciasullo, an Italian American master artisan with over 30 years of experience in the business. about:
G & E Steel Inc. operates from Salem, Massachusetts, serving the North Shore region of New England. The company was founded in 1976 by Antonio Ciasullo, an Italian‑American master artisan with decades of metalworking experience. After Ciasullo’s passing, his sons Gino and Emilio took over; Gino, a Bentley College graduate, serves as treasurer and chief operating officer, while Emilio, a Worcester Polytechnic Institute engineering graduate, holds the title of president and senior project manager. The business remains family‑owned and operated.

The shop specializes in custom stainless‑steel and carbon‑steel fabrication, producing railings, staircases, balconies, decks, and handicap‑accessible railings for both commercial and residential projects. Services cover the full project lifecycle: design assistance, field measurement, fabrication, delivery, and installation. The company also offers a one‑year warranty on fabricated work and provides free quotes. No facility size or employee count is published.

Customers include commercial contractors, private homeowners, and at least one federal agency (the United States Postal Service). The firm’s service area spans Salem, Swampscott, Marblehead, Gloucester, Newburyport, and surrounding Essex County communities.

G & E Steel positions itself as a one‑stop shop, handling every step from initial design through final installation. The founders’ emphasis on craftsmanship and the second generation’s engineering background are cited as the foundation of its reputation for reliable, custom metalwork.

name: GALAXY ELECTRONICS ASSOCIATES LLC
old_description: Galaxy Electronics Associates, Inc. was founded in 1988 with the intention of providing Quality Printed Circuit Boards to the electronics industry. As a result of our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we have achieved a steady and controlled growth.
about:
Galaxy Electronics Associates, Inc. was founded in 1988 in Laurel, Maryland, with the intention of providing quality printed circuit boards to the electronics industry. The company operates from a 22,000-square-foot facility in Laurel and has grown steadily over more than three decades.

The company manufactures a full range of printed circuit boards, including rigid, high-density interconnect (HDI), flex, rigid-flex, RF/microwave, and metal-core designs. Production capabilities cover single-sided through 14-layer multilayer boards with thicknesses from 0.002 to 0.200 inches, minimum line and space of 0.005 inches, and drilled holes down to 0.008 inches. Maximum panel size is 16 by 22 inches with copper weights up to 5 ounces. The shop supports prototype, quick-turn, and volume production runs, and offers design-for-manufacturability review as well as full PCB layout services with specialized RF and microwave expertise.

Galaxy Electronics serves original equipment manufacturers, engineers, and product teams across aerospace and defense, medical devices and healthcare, telecommunications and RF systems, automotive and EV electronics, and industrial automation and control. Its customer base spans the Mid-Atlantic region — Maryland, Washington D.C., Virginia, Pennsylvania, New York, and New Jersey — as well as national accounts.

The company emphasizes quality and customer service as its foundation, citing UL-approved processes, adherence to military and IPC specifications, and a commitment to on-time delivery. It also provides material selection guidance for substrates such as FR-4, PTFE, Rogers, Taconic, Arlon, and metal-core laminates to optimize signal integrity, thermal performance, and mechanical stability.
